mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_calendar_member (calendar_id, user_id, status, invited_by, joined_at) VALUES (#{calendarId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{invitedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMPNULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_calendar_member SET status = 'ACCEPTED', joined_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT invited_by FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.display_name) AS display_name FROM friend_connection fc JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN fc.requester_id = #{userId} THEN fc.addressee_id ELSE fc.requester_id END WHERE fc.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND (fc.requester_id = #{userId} OR fc.addressee_id = #{userId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_calendar_member m WHERE m.calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND m.user_id = u.id) ORDER BY display_name
mapper.update: UPDATE shared_calendar SET owner_id = #{ownerId} WHERE id = #{calendarId}
UPDATE shared_calendar SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{calendarId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' AND user_id <> #{exceptUserId} ORDER BY joined_at IS NULL, joined_at, created_at, user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_connection WHERE status = 'ACCEPTED' AND ((requester_id = #{a} AND addressee_id = #{b}) OR (requester_id = #{b} AND addressee_id = #{a}))
mapper.sql: c.id, c.name, c.owner_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(ou.nickname, ''), ou.display_name) AS owner_display_name, (c.owner_id = #{userId}) AS owner, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_calendar_member m2 WHERE m2.calendar_id = c.id AND m2.status = 'ACCEPTED') AS member_count, c.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM shared_calendar c JOIN shared_calendar_member m ON m.calendar_id = c.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACCEPTED' LEFT JOIN users ou ON ou.id = c.owner_id ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
SELECT FROM shared_calendar c LEFT JOIN users ou ON ou.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.id = #{calendarId}

SELECT c.id AS calendar_id, c.name AS calendar_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(iu.nickname, ''), iu.display_name) AS invited_by_display_name, m.created_at FROM shared_calendar_member m JOIN shared_calendar c ON c.id = m.calendar_id LEFT JOIN users iu ON iu.id = m.invited_by WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
SELECT status FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.display_name) AS display_name, m.status, (c.owner_id = u.id) AS owner, m.invited_by, m.joined_at FROM shared_calendar_member m JOIN shared_calendar c ON c.id = m.calendar_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.calendar_id = #{calendarId} ORDER BY (c.owner_id = u.id) DESC, m.status, m.joined_at IS NULL, m.joined_at, m.created_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE calendar_id = #{calendarId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED'
SELECT calendar_id FROM shared_calendar_member WHERE user_id = #{userId}
